procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the thirteen pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (the ROTATE_90 render is upside down -- banner 'Official Recapitulation 2026 GENERAL ELECTION'; cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/pearl/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (10/10 over table A, 5/5 over table B).
structure_note: Thirteen-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3+p4 = table A over the county's TWENTY-SEVEN precincts (11 columns AMACKERTOWN 2..MILL CREEK 2, then NICHOLSON 4..SALEM 4, then SPRINGHILL 2/SPRINGHILL 3/STEEP HOLLOW 3/SYCANORE 5/WHITESAND 1 + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 4, CoA 5 Position 1, and Chancery 10 Places 1-3; p5+p6+p7 = table B over the same column split carrying Chancery 10 Place 4, Circuit 15 Places 1-3, and the local county-court-judge + two Poplarville school sections; p8-p13 = the local tail (five more Poplarville Separate Municipal School Board sections). The sheet prints its county name as 'County of Pearl River' (this file's county field 'Pearl River', slug pearl_river, while the SoS file ships as 'Pearl_River_...'). Races: U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins); US House Of Rep 04-4th Congressional District (Mike Ezell REP first, then Jeffrey Hulum III DEM, then Carl Boyanton IND -- the House 4 roster, names identical, NINTH county); Court Of Appeals 05-District 5 Position 1 (Anthony 'Tony' Lawrence -- the CoA 5 roster alone, names identical, NINTH county); Chancery Court 10-Chancery District 10 Place 1 (Renee McBride Porter), Place 2 (Rhea Hudson Sheldon), Place 3 (Tara Kellar), Place 4 (Chad Smith) -- the FULL Chancery 10 four-place roster, names identical (FOURTH county with Lamar/Marion/Walthall); Circuit Court 15-Circuit District 15 Place 1 (Brad A. Touchstone), Place 2 (Ryan Bruhl, Prentiss G. Harrell), Place 3 (Richelle Lumpkin) -- the FULL Circuit 15 roster, names identical (FOURTH county). Printed totals: Colom 4115, Hyde-Smith 12080, Pinkins 685, Ezell 12485, Hulum 3713, Boyanton 677, Lawrence 13310, Porter 13338, Sheldon 13241, Kellar 13584, Smith 13389, Touchstone 13185, Bruhl 7382, Harrell 7453, Lumpkin 13580.
operator_rows_note: All 14 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3+p4 cells + the p4 printed TOTAL, table-B rows carry p5+p6+p7 cells + the p7 printed TOTAL. No X-cells in any in-scope row (Chancery 10 and Circuit 15 cover every Pearl precinct on this print). The local sections (Lisa Beech McGlothlin's county court judge, the five Poplarville PSD board sections) contribute no parse rows.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty-seven precinct headers print complete in the sheet's own numbered forms (AMACKERTOWN 2, CARRIERE 1, CARRIERE 3, CARRIERE 5, CEASAR 4, CROSSROADS 2, DERBY 1, GUMPOND/HICKORY GROVE 3, HENLEYFIELD 2, MCNEILL 3, MILL CREEK 2, NICHOLSON 4, PIC/HAWL,NH 5, PICAYUNE-1 EASTSIDE, PICAYUNE-1 SOUTHSIDE, PICAYUNE 2, PINE GROVE 4, POPLARVILLE 1, POPLARVILLE 2, POPLARVILLE 3, PROGRESS 3, SALEM 4, SPRINGHILL 2, SPRINGHILL 3, STEEP HOLLOW 3, SYCANORE 5, WHITESAND 1 -- kept verbatim including the PIC/HAWL,NH and PICAYUNE-1 split forms).
local_note: p5-p13 carry five LOCAL sections: 'Pearl River-County Court Judge' (Lisa Beech McGlothlin) and Poplarville Separate Municipal School Board Districts 1-5 (Kelly James-Penot, Christina Michelle Miller; Rachael Culpepper; Slade Jones; Beau Graham, Bobby Peterson Jr.; Jill Blossman Smith, Jonathan Leo Smith; Tyler Davis) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows. Chancery 10's printed Places are 1-4; Circuit 15's printed Places are 1-3 (Place 2 carries two candidates).
